title: The EU DPP Registry's API and battery data model are out: what to build before February 2027
subtitle: On 30 October 2026 the Commission published the Registry API, its authentication rules and the first semantic model, for batteries. Here is what a battery maker has to build now, and why a successful battery registration is not yet confirmed.
excerpt: Battery passports must be registered from 18 February 2027. The Commission's 30 October 2026 technical package for the EU DPP Registry adds a registration API, two authentication profiles and a semantic model for batteries. What to build now.
metaDescription: Battery passports must be registered from 18 February 2027. The Commission's 30 October 2026 technical package for the EU DPP Registry adds a registration API, two authentication profiles and a semantic model for batteries. What to build now.

cta.h2: Will your battery passport pass the Registry's checks?
cta.body: Tell us what you make and how your passport is hosted today. We tell you what is missing before 18 February 2027.
